0023da7eab4a.name: Exemplar of the Einhyr (Aura)
0023da7eab4a.plain: Aura: while one of your <LEAGUE> HEARTHGUARD units is within 6" of this model, models in that unit re-roll wound rolls of 1 for their attacks.

012d18f00314.name: Mounted Assault
012d18f00314.plain: If this unit has 2 models, then before the battle you can split a HEARTHKYN WARRIORS or BERSERKS unit with 10 models into two units of 5 models each. Do this at the start of the mission sequence's Declare Reserves and Transports step, and write down which models make up each new unit; they must begin the battle embarked within one of these two SAGITAUR models. In a Crusade mission, the Split Unit rules don't apply to INFANTRY units split this way: if the unit has any Battle Honours or Battle Scars, both halves count as having them, and you only take an Out of Action test for it if both halves are destroyed during the battle.

013a001818d3.name: The Last Crest of Jâluk
013a001818d3.plain:
The bearer:
- once per battle, can activate this Relic before a saving throw is made for it, to have a 3+ invulnerable save until the end of the phase.
- has a chance to avoid losing wounds to mortal wounds: each time it would lose one that way, roll one D6, and on a 4+ that wound isn't lost.

01aae7773335.name: Grimwrought Barrier
01aae7773335.plain: In your Command phase, pick one VOTANN unit from your army that is within 9" of one of your GRIMNYR models. Any psychic powers manifested by enemy units that are affecting that unit or its models stop affecting them. Also, until the start of your next Command phase, that unit and its models aren't affected by any Malediction psychic powers that are manifested.

02719a030b6f.name: Martial Cloneskins
02719a030b6f.plain: Models with this custom add 1 to the Strength characteristic of their melee attacks if their unit charged, was charged or made a Heroic Intervention this turn.

0611b4925975.name: Kinbond
0611b4925975.plain: At the start of the Fight phase, choose an enemy unit that 2 or more of your VOTANN CORE units are within Engagement Range of. For the rest of the phase, you can re-roll the wound roll whenever a VOTANN CORE model attacks that enemy unit in melee.

06bf0045a230.name: Core-buster Fire Pattern
06bf0045a230.plain: In your Shooting phase, once a beam weapon fired by one of your VOTANN models has hit an enemy unit: for the rest of the phase, roll one D6 whenever another beam weapon attack from one of your VOTANN models hits that enemy unit. On a 4+, it suffers 1 mortal wound on top of the normal damage. A unit can't suffer more than 6 mortal wounds per phase from this Stratagem.

073325d1059e.name: Eye of the Ancestors
073325d1059e.plain: This only applies if every unit in your army is a VOTANN unit and all of them come from one League, not counting UNALIGNED units. Enemy units gain Judgement tokens, and an enemy unit can have no more than 3. An enemy unit gains 1 token whenever it destroys a VOTANN unit from your army, and 1 whenever it completes an action or a psychic action. In addition, when each of your opponent's turns ends, select one enemy unit within range of an objective marker controlled by your opponent; that unit gains 1 token. A unit keeps its tokens until the battle ends. Each time a VOTANN model that isn't a COG model attacks a unit that has tokens: if the target has 1 token, an unmodified hit roll of 6 automatically wounds; with 2 tokens, an unmodified hit roll of 5+ automatically wounds; with 3 tokens, an unmodified hit roll of 4+ automatically wounds. Following GW's errata of 29 September 2022, an automatic wound from this never counts as an unmodified wound roll of 6.

0819db3ddafd.name: Warrior Pride
0819db3ddafd.plain: Each time it is picked to shoot or fight, a unit with this custom may re-roll a single hit roll or a single wound roll among its attacks.

0867e76572ed.name: Grudge's End
0867e76572ed.plain: One bolt weapon of your choice on the bearer counts as a Relic for all rules purposes, and its Damage and Armour Penetration characteristics each go up by 1. You pick that weapon when you give this Relic to a model. Whenever an attack from that weapon hits a unit with 1 or more Judgement tokens, it wounds the target automatically.

08fdbfd9da00.name: Pan spectral scanner
08fdbfd9da00.plain: When a model in the bearer's unit attacks with a ranged weapon, the target gets no benefit from Light Cover against that attack. The bearer's unit also gains the SCANNER keyword.

09f1501ce14e.name: The Hearthfist
09f1501ce14e.plain: When an attack from this weapon is allocated to an enemy model whose unit has one or more Judgement tokens, that attack's Damage characteristic is 4.

0d13edcb2156.name: Ion Storm
0d13edcb2156.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your VOTANN units is picked to shoot: for the rest of the phase, each attack a model in that unit makes with an ion weapon also inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target, on top of any normal damage, on an unmodified wound roll of 6 (capped at 6 mortal wounds). This Stratagem costs 2CP if that unit has 11 or more models, and 1CP otherwise.

116bfb5bb9dc.name: Ancestral Ward Crest
116bfb5bb9dc.plain: Every model in this unit has a 4+ invulnerable save.

11a3b06e4fb9.name: The Murmuring Stave
11a3b06e4fb9.plain:
The bearer:
- knows 1 extra power from the Skeinwrought discipline.
- can still try to manifest one psychic power in your Psychic phase after it attempts a psychic action.

165c4e45c004.name: Cyberstimms
165c4e45c004.plain: You can re-roll this unit's charge rolls. When a model in this unit is destroyed by a melee attack before it has fought this phase, leave it on the battlefield: it can fight once the attacking model's unit has finished its attacks, and is then removed.

1cbde6597193.name: Vôlumm's Master Artifice
1cbde6597193.plain: Beam weapon: its attacks have a Damage characteristic of 3 when allocated to any model whose Save characteristic is 3+ or better.

1cdbda820118.name: Crushing Contempt
1cdbda820118.plain: Malediction: if manifested, roll 3D6 to try to stop one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER from performing actions and to subtract 1 from its hit rolls. If the total equals or beats that unit's Leadership characteristic, then until the start of your next Psychic phase it can't perform actions (any action it is in the middle of fails at once). If the total is higher than its Leadership characteristic, then until the start of your next Psychic phase, subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack its models make.

21fb24cd7962.name: Omni-visors
21fb24cd7962.plain: When a model in this unit attacks with a ranged weapon, the target gets no benefit from Dense Cover against that attack.

2260e973cfdd.name: Outflanking Pioneers
2260e973cfdd.plain: At the start of your Movement phase, choose a HERNKYN PIONEERS unit of yours that is within 6" of any battlefield edge and more than 6" from every enemy model. If the mission you are playing uses the Strategic Reserves rules, move that unit into Strategic Reserves; it can't then arrive from Strategic Reserves in the same turn it was put there.

2a64f453994a.name: Mass Driver Accelerators
2a64f453994a.plain: When this model finishes a charge move, pick one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it and roll one D6. If you roll an unmodified 6, or a result equal to or higher than the highest Toughness characteristic among that unit's models, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

2bc9537a0599.name: Pan Spectral Warning
2bc9537a0599.plain: When the Reinforcements step of your opponent's Movement phase ends, choose a VOTANN SCANNER unit of yours that isn't within Engagement Range of any enemy units. It can shoot as though it were your Shooting phase, with one restriction: its models may only shoot at one eligible enemy unit, which must have been set up as Reinforcements this turn and must be within 12" of their unit.

2bd33690ea6f.name: Close Quarters Prioritisation
2bd33690ea6f.plain: Add 2 to the charge roll of a unit with this custom if it declares a charge against only one target and that target has 1 or more Judgement tokens.

2f1715b89f72.name: Sagitaur
2f1715b89f72.plain: This model's Transport capacity is 5 <LEAGUE> INFANTRY models, but it can't carry EXO-ARMOUR or EXO-FRAME models.

2f44d440f97b.name: Exactor
2f44d440f97b.plain: When an attack with this weapon gets an unmodified hit roll of 6, the attack sequence ends and the target suffers D3+3 mortal wounds.

32f5edf458af.name: Weavefield crest
32f5edf458af.plain: The bearer's Wounds characteristic becomes 6, and it gains a 4+ invulnerable save.

35ec272ac765.name: Volkanite disintegrator
35ec272ac765.plain: When an attack with this weapon gets an unmodified hit roll of 6, the target suffers 1 mortal wound and the attack sequence ends.

38e3b50ac7b4.name: Ancestral Bearing
38e3b50ac7b4.plain:
Two range boosts for this WARLORD:
- in your Command phase, when it uses an ability that has a range, you can add 3" to that range (to a maximum of 12").
- its aura abilities have 3" added to their range.

3934611b63a3.name: Bastion Running
3934611b63a3.plain: In your Command phase, choose a HEKATON LAND FORTRESS model of yours. Until your next Command phase begins, treat it as if it had lost no wounds when working out which characteristics on its profile to use.

3b7d4db1955c.name: Ancestor's vengeance warhead
3b7d4db1955c.plain: The bearer can fire this weapon just once per battle, and it can target units the bearer can't see. Attacks with it against a VEHICLE unit have a Damage characteristic of 3, and successfully wound on an unmodified wound roll of 4+.

3c773ce9839b.name: Taking It Personally
3c773ce9839b.plain: When a unit with this custom aims all its attacks at one enemy unit and damages but doesn't destroy it, that enemy unit has a chance to gain 1 Judgement token. Each time your unit is picked to shoot or fight and all of its attacking models target the same enemy unit, wait until those attacks are resolved. Then, if that enemy unit took damage from them but survived, roll one D6, adding 1 if it is now below Half-strength. On a 5+, it gains 1 Judgement token.

3caaad3fb189.name: Kôrvyk's Cuirass
3caaad3fb189.plain:
The bearer:
- gains a 4+ invulnerable save.
- reduces the Armour Penetration characteristic of each attack allocated to it by 1 (to a minimum of 0). This stacks with the similar bonus from the Void Armour ability.

3cfbfba12546.name: Superior Beam Capacitors
3cfbfba12546.plain:
With this custom:
- beam weapons that models are equipped with get 1 added to their Strength characteristic.
- the Core-Buster Fire Pattern Stratagem costs 0CP whenever a unit with this custom is selected for it.

40d6b4372cf4.name: Overcharged Shield Crest
40d6b4372cf4.plain: In any phase, when one of your VOTANN SHIELD CREST units is selected as a ranged attack's target: for the rest of the phase, every ranged attack made against that unit fails on an unmodified wound roll of 1-3, whatever abilities the weapon or attacking model have. This Stratagem costs 1CP if that unit has 5 or fewer models, and 2CP otherwise.

43b463eb73a7.name: Dour Survivalists
43b463eb73a7.plain:
Units with this custom:
- have 1 added to the Toughness characteristic of their models.
- can re-roll failed Morale tests.
Ancestral Judgement: whenever a model with this custom (other than a COG model) attacks a target with 0 Judgement tokens, treat that enemy unit as having 1 Judgement token when working out which bonuses that model's attacks get.

449bbdd4b97e.name: Blade of the Ancestors
449bbdd4b97e.plain: When an attack with this weapon gets an unmodified hit roll of 6, the attack sequence ends and the target suffers 2 mortal wounds, or 3 mortal wounds if it has one or more Judgement tokens.

4b663a9c60a4.name: Optimised Volley
4b663a9c60a4.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your VOTANN units is picked to shoot: until the end of the phase, whenever a model in that unit attacks with a bolt weapon, an unmodified hit roll of 6 scores one extra hit, or 2 extra hits if the target unit had 11 or more models when you used this Stratagem.

4d62959eb700.name: Guild Affiliate
4d62959eb700.plain: In your Command phase, you can give one of your <LEAGUE> CORE units within 6" of this WARLORD Objective Secured until the start of your next Command phase. If a model in that unit already has that ability, it counts as one extra model when working out control of an objective marker.

4e696b7b1ac6.name: Subterranean Explosives
4e696b7b1ac6.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your SUBTERRANEAN EXPLOSIVES units is picked to shoot: until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from the wound roll of each ranged attack it makes. If one of those attacks scores a hit against a target that isn't TITANIC and can't FLY, then until the start of your next Shooting phase, the Move characteristic of the target unit's models is halved, and the target unit can't fight until every other eligible unit from your army has fought. (Optional marker: you can place a Mole Grenade model beside affected enemy units and remove it at the start of your next Movement phase; it doesn't count as a model for any rules.)

4f50586def8f.name: Teleport crest
4f50586def8f.plain: During deployment, instead of putting this unit on the battlefield, you can place it in a teleportation dock. If you do, then in the Reinforcements step of any one of your Movement phases you can set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy models.

598b815407cf.name: CORV Support
598b815407cf.plain: When this unit suffers Perils of the Warp and still has at least 1 CORV model, destroy 1 of its CORV models and ignore the Perils of the Warp effect(s). CORV models being destroyed are ignored for Morale tests. If this unit's GRIMNYR model is destroyed, every CORV model left in the unit is destroyed with it.

5cdc09c03175.name: Vengeful
5cdc09c03175.plain: Whenever an enemy unit destroys a unit with this custom, the enemy unit gains 2 Judgement tokens.

5ce8b9b9a199.name: Multispectral Visor
5ce8b9b9a199.plain: In your Command phase, if this unit has a BRÔKHYR IRON-MASTER model, you can pick one of your <LEAGUE> CORE or <LEAGUE> VEHICLE units within 9" of this unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the hit roll whenever a model in that unit attacks with a ranged weapon.

5f7ca3d2219d.name: Ancestral Crest
5f7ca3d2219d.plain:
This Relic gives three effects:
- once per battle, you can use an Epic Deed Stratagem on the bearer for 0 Command points.
- once per battle, after a hit roll, wound roll or saving throw is made for the bearer, you can make that roll's result a 6; it counts as an unmodified 6 for all rules purposes.
- if the bearer is destroyed by an enemy unit, roll one D6 at the end of the phase. That enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds on a 2-5, or 3 mortal wounds on a 6.

60732116656e.name: Experienced Eye
60732116656e.plain: In each of your Command phases, this WARLORD can use its Grim Efficiency ability one extra time. It can only do so if you pick an enemy unit that hasn't already been picked for that ability this turn.

6205e94695f4.name: Grudgepyre
6205e94695f4.plain: Witchfire: if manifested, you can try to destroy one model in an enemy unit (not a VEHICLE, MONSTER or CHARACTER) this PSYKER can see within 18". Roll 2D6 and add the number of Judgement tokens beside that unit. If the total is higher than that unit's unmodified Leadership characteristic, your opponent chooses one model in the unit, and that model is destroyed.

630fbb4701b7.name: Magna-rail weapons
630fbb4701b7.plain: Your opponent can't take invulnerable saves against attacks from weapons with the Magna-rail ability. On an unmodified wound roll of 6, any excess damage such a weapon causes isn't lost: carry on allocating it to other models in the target unit until all the excess damage has been allocated or the unit is destroyed.

6729169ee16a.name: Light’em Up
6729169ee16a.plain: In your Shooting phase, after one of your VOTANN SEARCHLIGHT units has resolved its attacks, pick one enemy unit hit by at least one of that unit's ranged attacks this phase. If all units in your army come from the same League (not counting UNALIGNED units), that enemy unit gains 1 Judgement token.

682f71a5bf19.name: Familial Loyalty
682f71a5bf19.plain: In your opponent's Charge phase, choose a VOTANN INFANTRY or VOTANN BIKER unit of yours. For the rest of the phase, it can perform Heroic Interventions as though it were a CHARACTER.

6e5f5f772b7c.name: Ironkin Assistant
6e5f5f772b7c.plain: As long as this unit still has an IRONKIN ASSISTANT model, it can perform actions even after it Advanced, and shooting doesn't make its action fail.

6f47140e3d31.name: Reactive Reprisal
6f47140e3d31.plain: In your opponent's Shooting phase, once an enemy unit has resolved its attacks, if it had 1 or more Judgement tokens at the moment it was picked to shoot: pick one VOTANN CORE unit from your army that was hit by at least one of that enemy unit's attacks this phase and isn't within Engagement Range of any enemy units. It can shoot straight away as if it were your Shooting phase, but only at that enemy unit, and only if it is an eligible target. Afterwards, that VOTANN CORE unit can't shoot in your next Shooting phase. This Stratagem costs 1CP if the unit you picked is a unit of HEARTHKYN WARRIORS, and 2CP otherwise.

7430226c1bec.name: Quick to Judge
7430226c1bec.plain: An enemy unit that causes casualties to a unit with this custom without destroying it has a chance to gain 1 Judgement token. Whenever an enemy unit targets a unit with this custom with shooting or melee attacks, once the attacker has resolved all of its attacks: if your unit lost one or more models to them but wasn't destroyed, roll one D6, adding 1 if your unit is now below Half-strength. On a 4+, that attacking unit gains 1 Judgement token.

78389594fd44.name: Multiwave comms array
78389594fd44.plain: While within 24" of one of your <LEAGUE> KÂHL models, the bearer's unit counts as being in range of that model's Kindred Hero aura ability. It also gains the COMMS keyword.

7c01ce8b2aaa.name: A Long List
7c01ce8b2aaa.plain:
This WARLORD gets three effects:
- the target of each of its ranged attacks gets no benefit from Light Cover against that attack.
- you can ignore the Look Out, Sir rule for units with one or more Judgement tokens when picking targets for its ranged weapons.
- in each phase in which a <LEAGUE> unit from your army destroyed any enemy units that had Judgement tokens, pick one enemy unit visible to this WARLORD at the end of that phase: it gains 1 Judgement token.

7ccc2ecb6d79.name: Honour the Ancestors
7ccc2ecb6d79.plain:
Whenever a model with this custom attacks:
- if its unit is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the hit roll.
- on an unmodified wound roll of 6, improve the attack's Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.
Ancestral Judgement: whenever a model with this custom (other than a COG model) attacks a target with one or more Judgement tokens, a wound roll of 1 is re-rolled.

8040da5c2c48.name: Concussion Blast
8040da5c2c48.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your VOTANN CONCUSSION units is picked to shoot, choose one enemy unit within 6" of it. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, that enemy unit can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend, and its models subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack they make.

8239505b4d4c.name: Nomad Strategist
8239505b4d4c.plain: At the start of the first battle round, you can redeploy up to three of your TRANS-HYPERIAN ALLIANCE units that are wholly within your deployment zone. Remove them from the battlefield and set them up again anywhere wholly within your deployment zone. If the mission uses the Strategic Reserves rules, you can put any of those units into Strategic Reserves without paying any extra CPs, however many units are already there. If both players have redeploy abilities, roll off, and the winner picks which player redeploys their units first.

83839f4ac3da.name: Wârpestryk
83839f4ac3da.plain: During any Normal Move, Advance, Fall Back or charge move it makes, the bearer can pass horizontally through models and terrain features. It can't end that move on top of another model or its base. Enemy units arriving on the battlefield as Reinforcements can't be set up within 12" of this model's unit. Once per battle, using the Site-to-Site Teleport Stratagem on the bearer's unit costs 0 CP.

8449038b1349.name: Wayfarer's Grace
8449038b1349.plain:
With this Relic:
- the bearer gets back 1 lost wound at the start of each of your Command phases.
- the first time the bearer is destroyed, you can use this Relic in place of any rules that trigger on its destruction. If you do, roll one D6 when the phase ends; on a 3+, put it back on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, not within Engagement Range of any enemy models, with D3 wounds left.

852d1cded945.name: War Songs
852d1cded945.plain: A <LEAGUE> model with this custom can re-roll a melee hit roll if the target was in Engagement Range of 2 or more of your <LEAGUE> CORE units. This is checked at the moment the attacking unit was chosen to fight.

86277e955b91.name: Weavefield Crest
86277e955b91.plain: The Theyn in this unit has a 4+ invulnerable save.

862818d0a144.name: E-COG Support
862818d0a144.plain: When this unit uses its Brôkhyr's Guild ability and still has at least one E-COG model, the model it fixes gets back 1 more lost wound. Ignore E-COG models being destroyed when taking Morale tests. If this unit's BRÔKYR IRON-MASTER model is destroyed, every E-COG model left in the unit is destroyed with it.

8714b1ae2c7e.name: Pragmatic Wisdom
8714b1ae2c7e.plain: While this WARLORD is on the battlefield, you can roll one D6 for every Command point you spend on a Stratagem; on a 5+, you get that Command point back.

894090c45da9.name: Fortify
894090c45da9.plain: Blessing: until your next Psychic phase, models in one of your <LEAGUE> CORE or <LEAGUE> CHARACTER units within 12" of this PSYKER add 1 to their Toughness. You pick the unit when this power is manifested. Until the start of your next Psychic phase, each time one of its models loses a wound, also roll one D6: on a 6, that wound isn't lost.

8b490621f580.name: Combat Surgery
8b490621f580.plain: In your Command phase, choose a VOTANN MEDIC unit of yours that is under its Starting Strength and isn't within Engagement Range of any enemy units. Up to D3 of its destroyed models return to it.

8be025aa37a7.name: High Kâhl
8be025aa37a7.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your <LEAGUE> CORE or <LEAGUE> CHARACTER units within 6" of this model so you can re-roll its hit rolls. This lasts until the start of your next Command phase, and applies to every attack made by a model in that unit.

8f0228d6b717.name: Void Armour
8f0228d6b717.plain: Your opponent can't re-roll wound rolls or damage rolls for attacks that target this unit. Whenever an attack is allocated to one of this unit's models, lower that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic by 1 (minimum 0).

8f6fd0ffde74.name: Point-blank Fusillade
8f6fd0ffde74.plain: At the start of your Shooting phase, choose a VOTANN INFANTRY or VOTANN BIKER unit of yours. For the rest of the phase, its models can attack with ranged weapons even while their unit is within Engagement Range of enemy units, but only against enemy units they are within Engagement Range of (a beam weapon attack made this way is resolved only against that target unit and can't hit any other unit). When doing this, they can target an enemy unit even if other friendly units are also within Engagement Range of it. A model in this unit with two or more ranged weapons may still pick targets that aren't within Engagement Range of its unit, but that weapon only gets to make its attacks if every enemy unit within Engagement Range of the model's unit has been destroyed by the time you resolve them. Also, when a model in this unit fires a Heavy weapon while any enemy units are within Engagement Range of its unit, subtract 1 from the hit rolls for that weapon's attacks.

93c37781c1cc.name: Brutal Efficiency
93c37781c1cc.plain: Melee attacks by models with this custom (not COG models) score 1 extra hit on an unmodified hit roll of 6 when the target has 1 or more Judgement tokens.

97302bcf5a02.name: Multi-spectral Visor
97302bcf5a02.plain: In your Command phase, if this unit has a BRÔKYR IRON-MASTER model, you can pick one of your <LEAGUE> CORE or <LEAGUE> VEHICLE models within 9" of this unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the hit roll whenever a model in that friendly unit attacks with a ranged weapon.

9b04600df5d0.name: Master Armourers
9b04600df5d0.plain:
With this custom:
- every ranged weapon (other than Relics) that models are equipped with has 4" added to its Range characteristic.
- models with a Save characteristic of 2+ have a 4+ invulnerable save, and all other models have a 5+ invulnerable save.
Ancestral Judgement: whenever a model with this custom (other than a COG model) makes a ranged attack against a unit within half range that has one or more Judgement tokens, improve that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.

9cc097ba2d3d.name: Sagitaur Squadron
9cc097ba2d3d.plain: If this unit has 2 models, they must be within 6" of each other when it is first set up on the battlefield; after that, each model counts as a separate unit.

9cc6c645887b.name: Ymmâ's Shield
9cc6c645887b.plain: Once per battle round, when the bearer fails a saving throw, it can use this Relic to change that attack's Damage characteristic to 0. Each time it does, roll one D6. On a 5+, the unit that made the attack gains 1 Judgement token, but only if every model in your army has the VOTANN keyword and comes from the same League (UNALIGNED units excluded).

9ccd30510692.name: Waste Not Your Last Breath
9ccd30510692.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your URANI-SURTR REGULATES CHARACTER models is destroyed before it has been picked to fight this phase: don't remove it yet. It can fight once the attacking model's unit has finished its attacks, and it is removed after its own attacks are resolved.

9d08ed91ad9e.name: Darkstar axe
9d08ed91ad9e.plain: For each attack with this weapon, make 2 hit rolls rather than 1. When an attack from this weapon is allocated to an enemy model, that model can't use any rules that would let it ignore lost wounds.

9ddc6df7a0d7.name: Ruthless Efficiency
9ddc6df7a0d7.plain:
With this custom:
- models (not COG models) count as 2 models for controlling objective markers, or as 5 models if their Wounds characteristic is 10 or more.
- whenever a unit with this custom is picked to shoot or fight, you may re-roll a single hit roll or a single wound roll among its attacks.
Ancestral Judgement: whenever a model with this custom (other than a COG model) attacks a target that has one or more Judgement tokens, treat that enemy unit as having 1 more Judgement token than it really has (up to a maximum of 3) when working out which bonuses that model's attacks get.

9f4d511a253d.name: Cult of Veneration
9f4d511a253d.plain: In any phase, when a mortal wound would make one of your TRANS-HYPERIAN ALLIANCE models lose a wound: for the rest of the phase, whenever that model, or any other model in the same unit, would lose a wound due to a mortal wound, roll one D6; on a 5+ that wound isn't lost.

9fec4024b457.name: Guild Connections
9fec4024b457.plain: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of every weapon this WARLORD is equipped with, other than Relics.

a464b9338ca7.name: SP conversion beamer
a464b9338ca7.plain: Beam. When an attack with this weapon hits a unit that is wholly more than 15" away from the firing model, score one extra hit against that unit.

a4ebd776990b.name: The First Knife
a4ebd776990b.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it can make 1 extra attack using this weapon's close combat weapon profile. If that extra attack hits, the attack sequence ends and the target suffers D3 mortal wounds, plus 1 extra mortal wound per Judgement token on the target's unit.

a533566a551b.name: Unwavering Discipline
a533566a551b.plain: Against a target with 1 or more Judgement tokens, models with this custom (not COG models) can ignore hit roll, Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill modifiers. Each time one of these models attacks such a target, you can ignore any or all of those modifiers.

a53e7e5949d8.name: The Might of the Einhyr
a53e7e5949d8.plain: In your Shooting phase when one of your EINHYR units is picked to shoot, or in the Fight phase when one of your EINHYR units is picked to fight: until the end of the phase, add 1 to the hit roll of every attack made by a model in that unit.

a5e5dd6a8f9a.name: Rampart crest
a5e5dd6a8f9a.plain: The bearer's unit gains the SHIELD CREST keyword, and the bearer gains this ability. Rampart Shield (Aura): while one of your <LEAGUE> INFANTRY or <LEAGUE> BIKER units is within 6" of this model, that unit's models have a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks. Nothing (Ancestral Bearing, for example) can increase this ability's range.

a66148d28e7c.name: Void Hardened
a66148d28e7c.plain: Attacks made against a unit with this custom always fail on an unmodified wound roll of 1-2, whatever abilities the attacking weapon or model has.

a6f949cb8642.name: Interface Echo
a6f949cb8642.plain: Blessing: if it is manifested, you gain 1 Command point. CP you gain from this power ignore the usual cap of gaining or refunding 1 CP per battle round.

a8ae1b898ac6.name: Brôkhyr's Guild
a8ae1b898ac6.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, this unit can fix one of your <LEAGUE> VEHICLE or <LEAGUE> EXO-FRAME models that is within 3" of it. That model gets back up to D3 lost wounds. No model can be repaired more than once in a turn.

a8c90b16beed.name: Kindred Hero (Aura)
a8c90b16beed.plain: Aura: while one of your <LEAGUE> CORE units is within 6" of this model, models in that unit re-roll hit rolls of 1 for their attacks.

a9de517df180.name: Kin's wrath warhead
a9de517df180.plain: The bearer may fire this weapon a single time per battle, and may aim it at units it has no line of sight to.

aad063aca8a6.name: Grim Efficiency
aad063aca8a6.plain: In each of your Command phases, if all the units in your army come from the same League (not counting models with the UNALIGNED keyword), you can pick one enemy unit this model can see. That unit gains one Judgement token.

ab3c27c2950e.name: The Destined
ab3c27c2950e.plain: Whenever an attack is allocated to this model, that attack's Damage characteristic becomes 1.

ab864222d019.name: HunTR weapons
ab864222d019.plain: Many Votann ranged weapons are of the 'HunTR' type. A model firing a HunTR weapon makes as many attacks as the number printed after the type on that weapon's profile. For example, 'HunTR 1' gives 1 attack, 'HunTR 3' gives 3 attacks, and so on.

ac270862e770.name: Unrelenting Toil
ac270862e770.plain: Your <LEAGUE> CORE units that are performing an action can shoot without that action failing while they are within 6" of this WARLORD.

ae9549de836f.name: Rollbar searchlight
ae9549de836f.plain: When a model in the bearer's unit attacks with a ranged weapon, the target gets no benefit from Dense Cover against that attack. The bearer's unit also gains the SEARCHLIGHT keyword.

af37dabb1b48.name: Ranger Outriders
af37dabb1b48.plain: Before the first turn of the battle, at the start of battle round 1, this unit can make a Normal Move of up to 12" (treat it as your Movement phase). It must finish that move more than 9" from every enemy model. When both players have units able to do this, whoever is taking the first turn moves theirs first.

b19dc8d024cf.name: Grimnyr
b19dc8d024cf.plain: Powers: Smite, plus 2 of the powers from the Skeinwrought discipline.

b2c1f151e3f9.name: Weaponsmiths
b2c1f151e3f9.plain: Ranged weapons that models with this custom are equipped with (other than Relics) get 4" added to their Range characteristic.

b9b7764c6a74.name: Eye of the Ancestors
b9b7764c6a74.plain: The Eye of the Ancestors army rule (Judgement tokens) applies here, used as published together with its later updates and errata.

baad2af1e931.name: Accelerated Response
baad2af1e931.plain: In your Movement phase, when one of your VOTANN ACCELERATED units is picked to Advance: until the end of the phase, each model in that unit adds 12" to its Move characteristic. This doesn't stack with the similar bonus from the Steady Advance ability.

bcf1843d65b8.name: Weavefield crest
bcf1843d65b8.plain: The bearer's Wounds characteristic becomes 3, and it gains a 4+ invulnerable save.

c02f1355fd19.name: Warrior Lord
c02f1355fd19.plain:
For this WARLORD's melee attacks:
- you may re-roll the wound roll.
- an enemy model that one of them is allocated to can't use any rules to ignore the wounds it loses.

c0581226c89b.name: Aktôl's Fortress
c0581226c89b.plain: At the start of the Fight phase, you can pick one enemy unit within 3" of the bearer: it can't fight this phase until all your eligible units have fought.

c16056339eba.name: Exemplary Hero
c16056339eba.plain:
This WARLORD:
- gets 1 extra attack each time it fights within Engagement Range of any enemy CHARACTER or MONSTER units, until that fight is resolved.
- can re-roll the hit roll for each of its melee attacks.
- adds 1 to the wound roll for its melee attacks against an enemy CHARACTER or MONSTER unit.

c48bfd66437a.name: Mag-riders
c48bfd66437a.plain: In your opponent's Shooting phase, when one of your VOTANN BIKER units is selected as a ranged attack's target: for the rest of the phase, subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack made against that unit, and if that unit Advanced in its previous turn, those hit rolls can't be re-rolled.

c721ea571a1f.name: Huntr’s Mark
c721ea571a1f.plain: In your Shooting phase, before you make a hit roll for an attack by one of your VOTANN models: if the target unit has 1 or more Judgement tokens, skip the hit roll, because the attack hits automatically.

d24cb1ffe126.name: Honour in Toil
d24cb1ffe126.plain: While a unit with this custom is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the hit roll of every attack its models make.

d345961dc36c.name: Brôkhyr Forge-master
d345961dc36c.plain: Once per battle round, a Votann Wargear Stratagem you use on one of your <LEAGUE> units within 6" of this BRÔKYR FORGE-MASTER costs 1CP less. This only works while this model is on the battlefield, and only for that one use: later uses of the Stratagem cost the usual number of CP.

d3754e925fb9.name: New-found Nemesis
d3754e925fb9.plain: Use when one of your VOTANN WARLORD or GRIMNYR models is destroyed. The enemy unit which destroyed it gains 2 Judgement tokens, or 3 Judgement tokens instead if the model you lost was a GRIMNYR.

d5978ba788bc.name: Beam weapons
d5978ba788bc.plain: When an attack with a Beam weapon scores a hit, make one wound roll against the target and one against each other unit the beam's line passes over. Draw that line from the nearest point of the firing model's base (or hull) to the nearest point of the closest model in the target unit, and skip any unit that wasn't eligible to be targeted by this weapon when you picked targets. If a VEHICLE model makes beam weapon attacks that target an enemy in Engagement Range, each such attack is resolved only against the target unit and can't hit any other unit.

d6f9154f5069.name: Anger of the Ancestors
d6f9154f5069.plain: When a LORD GRIMNYR tries to manifest a Skeinwrought power, add 1 to its Psychic test if any enemy unit within 18" of it has 1 or more Judgement tokens.

d74b7fd1bab0.name: Legend of the League
d74b7fd1bab0.plain: Before the battle, while you muster your army, if your WARLORD has the VOTANN keyword: pick one VOTANN CHARACTER model from your army and give it one Warlord Trait it is allowed to have. That model counts as your WARLORD only for that Warlord Trait. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be different (if you roll them randomly, re-roll duplicates), and this Stratagem can't be used to give one model a second Warlord Trait. You can use it only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

d77ce74a5600.name: Lord Grimnyr
d77ce74a5600.plain: In each of your Psychic phases, this model can try to manifest one extra psychic power.

d7d4d03589d2.name: Battle Prowess
d7d4d03589d2.plain:
If a unit with this custom charged, was charged or performed a Heroic Intervention this turn:
- add 1 to its models' Attacks characteristic each time it fights. This lasts until that fight is resolved.
- add 1 to the Strength characteristic of each melee attack its models make.
Ancestral Judgement: whenever a model with this custom (other than a COG model) makes a melee attack against a target with 2 or more Judgement tokens, improve that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.

dcf009fe1e51.name: Site-to-site Transport
dcf009fe1e51.plain: At the start of your Movement phase, pick one VOTANN TELEPORTATION unit from your army and take it off the battlefield. In the Reinforcements step of this Movement phase, put it back on the battlefield anywhere more than 9" from all enemy models. No unit can be picked for this Stratagem more than once per battle. It costs 1CP if the picked unit was a CHARACTER, and 2CP otherwise.

dd4dd58d6fd9.name: Stoic
dd4dd58d6fd9.plain: Units with this custom can re-roll failed Morale tests.

ddc1b88d44b6.name: Grim Demeanour (Aura)
ddc1b88d44b6.plain:
Aura: while one of your <LEAGUE> CORE units is within 6" of this WARLORD:
- it may disregard any or all modifiers to its Leadership characteristic.
- you may disregard any or all modifiers whenever a Combat Attrition test is taken for it.

ddf061fc1ca1.name: Null Vortex
ddf061fc1ca1.plain: Malediction: if manifested, pick one enemy unit within 12" of this PSYKER: until your next Psychic phase begins, its models can't use invulnerable saves.

dfbfb342acc4.name: Mass Driver Accelerator
dfbfb342acc4.plain: When this model finishes a charge move, pick one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it and roll one D6. If you roll an unmodified 6, or a result equal to or higher than the highest Toughness characteristic among that unit's models, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

e0ffc263ba56.name: Multiwave System Jammer
e0ffc263ba56.plain: At the start of any phase, pick one VOTANN COMMS unit from your army, then pick one enemy unit within 12" of it. Until the end of the phase, Aura abilities of units in your opponent's army can't affect that enemy unit.

e14bd845b4d5.name: Explodes
e14bd845b4d5.plain: If this transport is destroyed, roll one D6 before taking it off the battlefield and before any models inside it disembark. On a 6, it explodes, and every unit within 6" suffers 1 mortal wound.

e2126b093a4d.name: Personal Grudge
e2126b093a4d.plain: In your Command phase, pick one VOTANN CHARACTER unit from your army and one enemy unit on the battlefield. For the rest of the battle, whenever a model in that CHARACTER unit attacks the chosen enemy unit, treat the enemy unit as having 3 Judgement tokens when working out which bonuses the attacking model's attacks get. You can only use this Stratagem if all units in your army come from the same League (not counting UNALIGNED units), and only once per battle (twice in an Onslaught battle).

e286a9387dbb.name: Well-ordered Retreat
e286a9387dbb.plain: In your Movement phase, when one of your VOTANN CORE units Falls Back: it can still shoot this turn despite having Fallen Back.

e28aba11e3a8.name: Appraising Glare
e28aba11e3a8.plain: Use this when a GREATER THURIAN LEAGUE KÂHL model of yours uses its Grim Efficiency ability: the enemy unit it selected gets one extra Judgement token.

e63b0131c218.name: Ancestral Wrath
e63b0131c218.plain: Witchfire: if manifested, pick one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER that it can see, and roll dice to inflict mortal wounds on it. Roll 3 dice, or 6 dice instead if that unit has 11 or more models. If the unit has one or more Judgement tokens, add 1 to every result. Each roll of 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on that unit.

e69736940c41.name: Pulsed Beam Discharge
e69736940c41.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your YMYR CONGLOMERATE units is picked to shoot, pick one model in it and one beam weapon that model has. Until the end of the phase, every hit scored with that weapon also inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target, on top of the normal damage.

e9d2ed34e998.name: Bequest of the Votann
e9d2ed34e998.plain: Only once per battle, before the battle: pick one Theyn or Hesyr model from your army. Even though it isn't a CHARACTER model, it can take one of these Ancestral Relics: The Grey Crest, Grudge's End, The Hearthfist or Wârpestryk. Every Relic in your army must be different.

eab1c9905706.name: The Grey Crest
eab1c9905706.plain: If the bearer is a CHARACTER model, subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack made against the bearer. If the bearer isn't a CHARACTER model, subtract 1 from the hit roll of attacks made against the bearer's unit by attackers more than 12" away.

ebf867e3f0c3.name: Grimnyr's Regard (Aura)
ebf867e3f0c3.plain: Aura: while one of your <LEAGUE> CORE units is within 6" of this unit, that unit adds 1 to its Combat Attrition tests.

edd1f834feea.name: Cyberstimm Infusion
edd1f834feea.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your VOTANN BESERKS units is picked to fight: until the end of the phase, you can re-roll the hit roll for melee attacks made by models in that unit.

ef52613eef4c.name: Ancestral Sentence
ef52613eef4c.plain: In your Shooting phase when one of your VOTANN units is picked to shoot, or in the Fight phase when one of your VOTANN units is picked to fight: until the end of the phase, you can re-roll the hit roll whenever a model in that unit attacks a target that has 1 or more Judgement tokens.

ef940403da37.name: Efficient Exemplar
ef940403da37.plain: When a HIGH KÂHL model destroys an enemy unit that had 1 or more Judgement tokens, you can give one Judgement token to one enemy unit this model can see.

f07e3e2640a9.name: Forgemaster's Eye
f07e3e2640a9.plain: Against a target with 1 or more Judgement tokens, a BRÔKYR FORGE-MASTER model's unmodified wound roll of 6 deals mortal wounds equal to the attack's Damage. The attack sequence then ends. When a BRÔKYR FORGE-MASTER model attacks with a beam weapon, this also works against other units the beam "hits" along its line, as long as they have at least one Judgement token.

f32084361ad2.name: Rampart Shield (Aura)
f32084361ad2.plain: Aura: while a <LEAGUE> INFANTRY or <LEAGUE> BIKER unit of yours is within 6" of this model, models in it have a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks. Nothing can increase this ability's range.

f3b914fcbac9.name: In the Right Hands
f3b914fcbac9.plain: Before the battle, while you muster your army, if your WARLORD has the VOTANN keyword: pick one VOTANN CHARACTER model from your army and give it one Ancestral Relic it is allowed to take. Every Relic in your army must be different, and this Stratagem can't be used to give one model a second Relic. You can use it only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

f4c0df06b8b0.name: Bloody Expectations
f4c0df06b8b0.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your KRONUS HEGEMONY units is chosen to fight: for the rest of the phase, melee attacks by its models score 1 extra hit on an unmodified hit roll of 6.

f50396c6b8e7.name: Refined Power Cores
f50396c6b8e7.plain: Models with this custom that have the ACCELERATED or VEHICLE keyword get 2" added to their Move characteristic.

f55fee5ee551.name: Luck Has. Need Keeps. Toil Earns.
f55fee5ee551.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, choose a VOTANN CORE INFANTRY unit of yours that is in range of an objective marker. Until your next Movement phase begins, as long as it remains in range of that marker: it passes Morale tests automatically; unless it makes a ranged attack or declares a charge, it can ignore any rules that would make actions it is performing fail; and whenever one of its models would lose a wound, roll one D6, and on a 6 the wound isn't lost.

f67827c6252d.name: Master Armourer
f67827c6252d.plain:
This WARLORD:
- restores up to 3 lost wounds instead of D3 each time it repairs a model with its Brôkhyr's Guild ability. While this BRÔKYR FORGE-MASTER's unit includes 1 or more E-COG models, the repaired model regains up to 4 lost wounds instead (as the E-COG Support ability describes).
- once per battle round, when a saving throw is failed for one of your <LEAGUE> VEHICLE or <LEAGUE> EXO-FRAME models within 6" of it, can use this trait to change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

f6ee1c20ff98.name: Ancestral Fortune
f6ee1c20ff98.plain: Once per battle round, you can change one roll to a 6: a hit roll, wound roll, damage roll or saving throw made for this model or for one of your GREATER THURIAN LEAGUE models within 6" of it. That roll counts as an unmodified 6 for all rules purposes.

f8e1f4259636.name: Rampart crest
f8e1f4259636.plain: Rampart Shield (Aura): while one of your GREATER THURIAN LEAGUE INFANTRY or GREATER THURIAN LEAGUE BIKER units is within 6" of this model, that unit's models have a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks. Nothing (Ancestral Bearing, for example) can increase this ability's range.

f97415faa0a8.name: Augmented
f97415faa0a8.plain: Whenever a model in this unit loses a wound, roll one D6, and add 1 to the roll if the attack's Damage characteristic was 1. On a 5+, the wound isn't lost.

fa1f3e7faaa7.name: Steady Advance
fa1f3e7faaa7.plain: You can ignore any or all modifiers to this unit's Move characteristic, Advance rolls and charge rolls. When this unit Advances, skip the Advance roll; instead, for the rest of the phase, each of its models adds 3" to its Move characteristic (6" if this unit is ACCELERATED).

fcc798ada82a.name: Ancestral Power
fcc798ada82a.plain: Skeinwrought discipline psychic powers that this WARLORD manifests have their range increased by 6".

fe2c2e1a0875.name: Medipack
fe2c2e1a0875.plain: Once per turn, the first time the bearer's unit fails a saving throw, that attack's Damage characteristic becomes 0. The bearer's unit also gains the MEDIC keyword.

ffb8565aab5f.name: The CORV Duas
ffb8565aab5f.plain:
With this Relic:
- this unit's CORV gets 1 added to its Wounds characteristic.
- while the bearer's unit includes 1 or more CORV models, the bearer can try to deny 1 extra psychic power during each of your opponent's Psychic phases.
- as long as the bearer's unit includes 1 or more CORV models, the bearer adds 1 to its Deny the Witch tests.
